headline: Two two-week tests are built and live, with no backend and nothing outward. C: instructors make a class code on /instruktor/; learners send a summary link from Postup; the class lives on the instructor's phone. D: opt-in Otázka dne on home, the same question for everyone, a streak on the device; the weekly ranking exists only within a class (route 1) until Pavol picks a data route.

tests.name: Exam prep through instructors and clubs
tests.starts: the day Pavol sends the offers in docs/outreach/2026-11-instructors/ (not sent; drafts only)
tests.stop_rule: fewer than 2 of the 10 recipients bring 5 or more learners (key_action class_create with their ref, then distinct class_join / class_send per class)

tests.name: Otázka dne, practised together
tests.stop_rule: fewer than 30 opt-ins, or under 40 % of opt-ins still answering on day 14

decisions.question: Living docs this repo lacked
decisions.why: The standard names a living architecture doc and a revert log for every repo.

decisions.question: PRD said 'Social/leaderboards' is a non-goal
options: change the docs first, defer the public ranking
decisions.default_taken: docs first (PR #34): public leaderboards wait for Pavol's OK; SIGNATURE log notes the tension with 'toy gamification'
decisions.why: Feature-sessions standard: a change of direction goes into the living docs before code.

decisions.question: How the learner's summary reaches the instructor without a backend
options: link with the summary in the URL fragment
decisions.default_taken: fragment link /instruktor/#z1.<base64url JSON>, about 800 characters at most
decisions.why: No server, no table; the fragment is never sent to a server.

decisions.question: Where the instructor's class lives
decisions.default_taken: localStorage, with guidance on the page (same browser, not inside WhatsApp/Messenger; visit weekly because Safari can clear site data)
decisions.why: No new tables. Known limit: no export yet.

decisions.question: Counting the offers
options: a ref per recipient in the offer link
decisions.default_taken: ?ref=k01..k10 kept on the class and sent with class_create
decisions.why: The stop rule needs per-recipient counts; refs carry no personal data. Names stay outside the public repo.

decisions.question: Otázka dne question selection
options: a frozen order of the bank
decisions.default_taken: data/daily-order.json, frozen order, new ids appended
decisions.why: Same question for everyone whatever build they run; no repeat for 837 days (review found the seeded shuffle depended on the build).

decisions.question: Does Otázka dne touch the lesson streak?
decisions.default_taken: its own streak on the device; the answer still counts in progress
decisions.why: Quiz-rounds rule (answers count) without inflating the lesson streak.

decisions.question: Ranking
options: route 1: within a class, from summaries
route 2: nightly static JSON with nicknames
decisions.default_taken: route 1 built; routes 2 and 3 not built
decisions.why: Route 1 needs nothing from Pavol; the others need his OK (see proposals).

proposals.title: Weekly Otázka dne ranking across all participants
proposals.needs_pavol: Pick a route. Route 2 (recommended if the opt-ins pass the stop rule): learners choose a nickname, qotd_answer carries it in key_action props, the nightly flywheel KPI job publishes ranking.json to the site. Needs his OK to store a chosen nickname in the shared events table and to publish it, plus a flywheel job change; no new table, no new event name; anyone can forge entries since the insert is anonymous. Route 3: a qotd_answers table with RLS and sign-in for participants.

proposals.title: Send the instructor offers
proposals.needs_pavol: Pick 10 recipients (4 instructors, 3 clubs, 3 ranges suggested), fill names outside the repo, send from docs/outreach/2026-11-instructors/. Test C starts that day.
